final: WITH customer_orders AS (SELECT c.customer_id, c.gender, COUNT(o.order_id) as num_orders FROM Customers c INNER JOIN Orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE c.gender IS NOT NULL GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.gender), gender_totals AS (SELECT gender, SUM(num_orders) as gender_total FROM customer_orders GROUP BY gender), with_shares AS (SELECT co.customer_id, co.gender, co.num_orders, CAST(co.num_orders AS FLOAT) / gt.gender_total as share FROM customer_orders co JOIN gender_totals gt ON co.gender = gt.gender), avg_share_val AS (SELECT AVG(share) as avg_share FROM with_shares) SELECT ws.customer_id, ws.gender, ws.num_orders, ws.share, ws.share - av.avg_share as gap FROM with_shares ws, avg_share_val av WHERE ws.share > av.avg_share ORDER BY gap DESC LIMIT 10
